name: Fade the London first hour (03:00→04:00 ET)
why: European cash desks and stop runs push the first London hour too far in thin NQ liquidity; with no US flow until 08:30 the move is not backed by the participants who set the day’s direction, and early London momentum traders unwind before New York. Pre-registered 2026-10-19 (research/preregistered/2026-10-19_london_fade.md).
